about: A set's live session (issue #247, docs/live-session.md): every change is an op from a person on a device, applied by one function wherever the session runs - the API, or Oneverse Pulse when the room runs on its own - so the two never disagree on what a command does.

applyLiveOp.about: The session after an op, at `now` (ms): `{ok, changed, session}` (session null: none, or ended), or `{ok: false, code, message}` refused as forbidden, stale or bad-request. Each change goes up `rev`; a change of what's presented goes up `presentingRev` too, which a command's `basedOn` is checked against.

cueTarget.about: Where a cue goes (issue #322): the first slide of the next or previous item, or section - past an item's last section the next item's first, before its first the previous item's last; back from inside a section, its own start. Nothing shown, or an item no longer in the set: the first item. Null: nowhere to go.
